newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish pension funds' boom expect to continue.
newsitem.headline: Spanish pension funds' boom expect to continue.

text.p: Spain's private pension funds, whose assets rose around 50 percent to three trillion pesetas in 1996, could grow even more this year, fund association Inverco said on Monday.
Inverco said it expected Spanish pension funds to expand by some one billion pesetas this year.

"We had a lower amount in the average provisions. This is a good signal because it means than you have younger participants, instead of older ones, who contribute mainly for fiscal reasons," said Encarna Davila, who is responsible for pension funds at Inverco.
She added that the sector has very good potential in Spain in comparison with other European countries.

But she also advised that a reform in the law was needed in order to give pension funds increased liquidity -- allowing contributors to withdraw money under specific circumstances, and to improve the tax regime.
